description: Returns the exact <script> snippet to install the Consentio cookie banner for a site key, plus the install guide URL for the platform. Does not need an API key.

platform.description: Optional platform of the website (wordpress, shopify, wix, webflow, squarespace, prestashop, framer, carrd…).

siteKey.description: Site key from the dashboard, format cs_ + 32 hex characters.
